capabilities: Browse book, film, general and image collection cards in multiple 3D carousel layouts
Edit card summaries, categories, covers and linked notes from the card's flip side
Embed card collections in notes via generated code blocks
Organize cards into dashboard categories and sort them by drag or keyboard
Import book lists from WeChat Reading with publication dates
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; it renders showcase cards for books, films, images and other collections.
extras: Interface is Chinese only (an English guide is linked separately). Author code is proprietary since 0.9.0 with the public repo used only for installs, docs and issues; free for personal and commercial use, with voluntary donations via Ko-fi, Alipay or WeChat. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; mobile platforms are partially unverified on real devices.

problem: Obsidian has no visual, poster-style way to browse collections of books, films or images stored as notes; they appear only as plain lists or file views.
